title: A békedelegáció és Apponyi beszéde (Negotiating the Peace)
grammar: Causal-Consequence Discourse, Treaty Formulations & Transnational Identity Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe how the Hungarian delegation argued for Hungary in Paris in 1920.
I can give a reason with azért, hogy and name the arguments the delegation used.
I can use the words for the peace delegation, the Red Map and the ethnic principle.
I can read a short account of the Paris negotiations and answer questions about it.
